name: aware-weight-trend-from-home
why: The coach knows what the other screens show (28 Nov 2026, Ashley: 'the chat is aware of what's in the rest of the app'). Home's weight row holds 68.0 kg, down 0.4 kg over two weeks; the goal is fat loss. The answer must use those figures (a slow, steady loss, about 0.2 kg a week), never a generic 'weigh yourself daily'.
messages: is my weight actually going the right way?
